BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 6.2.5.2, Eq 6.6.3 (part 1 p. 900, gazette p. 3481): modulus of rupture fr = 0.62 λ √f'c

sources.slender: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 6.6.8.2-6.6.8.4 (pp. 971-972): simply supported panel, constant section, tension-controlled, φMn >= Mcr, Pu/Ag <= 0.06 f'c, Mu = Mua + Pu Δu with Δu = 5 Mu lc² / (0.75 × 48 Ec Icr), Icr by Eq 6.6.95 with Es/Ec >= 6, service Δs <= lc/150 by Eqs 6.6.96-6.6.99
sources.slender.ruptureCoefficient: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Eq 6.6.3 (p. 900): fr = 0.62 λ √f'c. Sec 6.6.8.2.4 refers to 'Eq. 6.6.91' for fr, which is the strength equation: a misprint, Eq 6.6.3 is the modulus of rupture of Chapter 6
sources.slender.spreadSlope: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 6.6.8.2.5 (p. 971): concentrated loads spread at 2 vertical to 1 horizontal
sources.gradeBeam: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 6.6.7.1-6.6.7.2 (p. 970): top and bottom steel for the moment by Sec 6.3.2-6.3.7, shear by Sec 6.4; the part exposed above grade also meets Sec 6.6.3
